description: NimbleBrain's Renovate policy: when Renovate runs, how long a release waits, and how majors and security fixes are handled. Which managers run and which packages group together belong to each repo's own renovate.json.

lockFileMaintenance.description: A refresh has no single release date, so Renovate's release-age check would hold it pending forever. A repo that wants the 14-day window on refreshes enforces it in its package manager (bunfig.toml, or uv's exclude-newer).
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A security fix skips the schedule, the release wait, and dashboard approval.
